item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find direct 2024 evidence of an ally, proxy, client, or domestic faction seeking proliferation for short-term political gain, Biden approving such proliferation, or a public confrontation where he had to choose whether to stop it. The record is strong on pro-resistance policy and weak on direct conflict cases. The absence of a visible crisis is the main limitation here.","evidence":[{"title":"Statement by the United States on the Twentieth Anniversary of UNSCR 1540","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"2024-04-29","url":"https://2021-2025.state.gov/statement-by-the-united-states-on-the-twentieth-anniversary-of-unscr-1540/","summary":"The United States called UNSCR 1540 one of the most important tools against proliferation and urged states to keep sensitive WMD-related goods and know-how under regulatory control.
